name: Izumi (Kagoshima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Izumi city emblem in light blue and blue: a light blue disc bearing white cranes above blue waves.
history: Municipal flag of Izumi, a city in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 13 March 2006.

features.role: Izumi city emblem — a light blue disc bearing white cranes above blue waves
